acceptance: Eight strict groups; five distinct strings per group, each matches its position grammar and source frame, no original reuse; then explicit text review. Abstentions/failures retained; no retry or filling.

generation.constraint: Per-request native GBNF in the grammar field; no unconstrained fallback

input_role: Same eight reviewed development source frames, different native token constraint mechanism; closed free-rewrite experiments are not restarted.
preparation_change: Restrict movement-to-lower-right phrases to explicit to, avoiding in/at ambiguity before native inference.

protected_frame_contract.scope: Controlled-form recognition for reviewed training frames; not open-language semantic verification

qualification_success_is_not: A full reviewed language bank, scene validation, proof of generalization, or an isolated estimate of model capacity effects
server_binding: 127.0.0.1 only; offline; no web UI; stopped after the bounded run
surface_form_limit: Human-reviewed finite forms restrict lexical diversity; no independent evidence of arbitrary-language equivalence or full-pool quality.
system_and_user_messages: Saved source instruction plus reviewed role names and explicit controlled-generation notice
